questions.question: A spherical metal of radius 10 cm is molten and made into 1000 smaller spheres of equal sizes. In this process the surface area of the metal is increased by:
questions.solution:
Given:

Radius of the original spherical metal = 10 cm

Number of smaller spheres = 1000

Formula Used:

Volume of sphere = (4)/(3)πr3

Surface area of sphere = 4πr2

Calculation:

If the radius of a smaller sphere be 'r cm' then

Acoording to the question:

(4)/(3)π(10)3 = 1000(4)/(3)π(r)3

r = 1 cm

Surface area of the larger sphere = 4π(10)2 = 400π

Total surface area of 1000 smaller spheres = 1000 × 4π(1)2 = 4000π

Net increase in the surface area = 4000π − 400π = 3600π

Increase compared to the original surface area = 3600π/400π = 9

Hence, surface area of the metal is increased by 9 times.

questions.question: In a linear race of 1000 m, A beats B by 50 m or 5 seconds. What is the difference between the speeds (in m/s) of A and B?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Speed of B** = Distance gap ÷ Time gap = 50 m ÷ 5 s = 10 m/s.

**Time taken by B** to finish the race = 1000 m ÷ 10 m/s = 100 s.

**Time taken by A** = 100 s − 5 s = 95 s.

**Speed of A** = 1000 m ÷ 95 s = 200/19 m/s.

**Speed Difference** = Speed of A − Speed of B = 200/19 − 10 = (200 − 190)/19 = 10/19 m/s.

**∴ The correct answer is 10/19 m/s.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total Race Distance = 1000 m

A beats B by distance = 50 m

A beats B by time = 5 s

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfe3b67ef48004ea7e347bdabf9042972bedd3dfbac9036240d37cf5403a0923.png] 

This implies that when **A** finishes the race (covers 1000 m), **B** is 50 m behind the finish line and takes 5 seconds more to cover that distance.

⇒ **Speed of B** = Distance covered ÷ Time taken = 50 m ÷ 5 s = 10 m/s

⇒ **Time taken by B** to complete 1000 m = 1000 m ÷ 10 m/s = 100 s

⇒ **Time taken by A** to complete 1000 m = Time of B − Time gap = 100 s − 5 s = 95 s

⇒ **Speed of A** = Total Distance ÷ Time of A = 1000 m ÷ 95 s = 200/19 m/s

⇒ **Difference in speeds** = Speed of A − Speed of B = (200/19) − 10

⇒ Difference = (200 − 190) ÷ 19 = 10/19 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 10/19 m/s.**

**__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Motion Formula

The core relationship in problems involving movement is: **Speed = Distance ÷ Time**.

Concepts of Beating in Races

If **A beats B** by 'd' meters, then when A covers **L** distance, B covers **(L − d)**. If A beats B by 't' seconds, then B's total time is **TimeA + t**.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the **same direction**, their relative speed is the **difference** of their individual speeds (V₁ − V₂).</p

questions.question: AB is the diameter of a semicircle. C is a point on line AB, AC = 6 cm, D is the point on the semicircle such that CD is perpendicular to AB and CD = 9 cm. Find the diameter of the semicircle.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

AB is the diameter of a semicircle.

AC = 6 cm

CD is perpendicular to AB.

CD = 9 cm

**Formula used:**

Using Pythagoras theorem in ΔACD:

AC² + CD² = AD²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2045412be4dc7c6e4f4cc2deaab0c158569f9bc549c0e1d48134c76bd5884f6.png] 

⇒ AD² = AC² + CD²

⇒ AD² = 6² + 9²

⇒ AD² = 36 + 81 = 117

⇒ AD = √117

In ΔCBD,

⇒ BD² = CD² + CB²

⇒ BD² = 81 + x²

In ΔABD,

⇒ AB² = AD² + BD²

⇒ (6 + x)² = 117 + 81 + x²

⇒ 36 + 12x + x² = 198 + x²

⇒ 12x = 162

⇒ x = 13.5

⇒ AB = 6 + 13.5 = 19.5 cm

**∴ The diameter of the semicircle is 19.5 cm.**

questions.question:
In triangles ABD and FEC, ∠BAD = 60°, l(BD) = l(EC), ∠ABD = ∠FEC = 90°, and l(AB) = l(FE). Find the ratio of (∠BAD)/(∠FCE).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d3e43583d1eec06334c29c5624f9485cd4f5c93e05ce129a19a0c82fdc13e2d.png]
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In right ΔABD, tan(∠BAD) = BD ÷ AB.

Since ∠BAD = 60°, BD ÷ AB = tan(60°) = √3.

In right ΔFEC, tan(∠FCE) = FE ÷ EC.

Since FE = AB and EC = BD, tan(∠FCE) = AB ÷ BD = 1 ÷ √3.

Thus, ∠FCE = 30°.

Ratio of ∠BAD to ∠FCE = 60° : 30° = 2:1.

**∴ The correct answer is 2:1.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

∠BAD = 60°

∠ABD = ∠FEC = 90°

l(BD) = l(EC) and l(AB) = l(FE)

**Formula Used:**

tan(θ) = Opposite Side ÷ Adjacent Side

**Calculations:**

⇒ In ΔABD, tan(∠BAD) = BD ÷ AB

⇒ tan(60°) = BD ÷ AB

⇒ BD ÷ AB = √3

⇒ BD = AB × √3

⇒ In ΔFEC, tan(∠FCE) = FE ÷ EC

⇒ Since FE = AB and EC = BD (Given), we substitute these lengths:

⇒ tan(∠FCE) = AB ÷ (AB × √3)

⇒ tan(∠FCE) = 1 ÷ √3

⇒ ∠FCE = 30°

⇒ Ratio of ∠BAD to ∠FCE = 60° ÷ 30°

⇒ Ratio = 2:1

**∴ The correct answer is 2:1.**

**__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios in Right Triangles

For any right-angled triangle, tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base. Key values to remember: tan(30°) = 1 ÷ √3, tan(45°) = 1, and tan(60°) = √3.

Side-Angle-Side (SAS) Congruence

Two triangles are congruent if two sides and the included angle of one are respectively equal to the corresponding sides and angle of the other.

Complementary Angles

In a right-angled triangle, the sum of the two acute angles is always 90°. Therefore, if one acute angle is 60°, the other automatically measures 30°.

questions.question: Calculate the cylinder’s total surface area if its radius is 7 cm and height is 12 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the cylinder (r) = 7 cm

Height of the cylinder (h) = 12 cm

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of a cylinder = 2πr(r + h)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total surface area = 2 × 22/7 × 7 × (7 + 12)

⇒ 44 × 19

⇒ 836 cm²

**∴ The answer is 836 cm².**

questions.question: A cricketer average 28 runs per inning for 26 innings. If he makes a total 272 runs in his next five innings, by how much will his average increase?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Net surplus runs = New runs − (Old average × Number of new innings)

Net surplus = 272 − (28 × 5) = 272 − 140 = 132 runs

Increase in average = Net surplus ÷ Total innings

Increase in average = 132 ÷ (26 + 5) = 132 ÷ 31 ≈ 4.258

**∴ The correct answer is 4.258.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Old average = 28 runs, Old innings = 26, New runs = 272, New innings = 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d326fcdd3944ba55dd8d4b3c624706c459b05ad98be818aa85c3a838f3835e0.png] 

⇒ **Total runs** in first 26 innings = 26 × 28 = 728 runs

⇒ **Total runs** after 31 innings = 728 + 272 = 1000 runs

⇒ **New average** = Total runs ÷ Total innings = 1000 ÷ 31

⇒ New average ≈ 32.258 runs

⇒ **Increase in average** = New average − Old average = 32.258 − 28 = 4.258

**∴ The correct answer is 4.258.**

**__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean (Average)

The average of a set of numbers is the sum of the numbers divided by the total count: Average = Sum ÷ n.

Net Deviation Method

The change in average is equal to the net extra value brought in by new observations divided by the new total number of observations.

Combined Average

If two groups with sizes n₁, n₂ and averages A₁, A₂ are combined, the new average is (n₁A₁ + n₂A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p

questions.question: A and B can do a piece of work in 24 days and 48 days, respectively. working together, they completed the work in 12 days with the help of C. How long (in days) will C take of do five-sixth of the work all by himself?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Total Work** (LCM of 24, 48, 12) = 48 units.

Efficiencies: **A** = 2, **B** = 1, **A+B+C** = 4.

Efficiency of **C** = 4 − (2 + 1) = 1 unit/day.

Work for **C** = 5/6 × 48 = 40 units.

Time taken by **C** = 40 ÷ 1 = 40 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 days.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **A** = **24 days**, **B** = **48 days**, and **A+B+C** = **12 days**.

**Formula Used:** Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time Taken

 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 **A**

 48 (LCM)
 2
 
 

 **B**
 48

 4
 
 

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = Efficiency of (A+B+C) − Efficiency of (A+B)

⇒ Efficiency of **C** = 4 − (2 + 1) = 1 unit/day.

⇒ **Five-sixth** of the total work = (5/6) × 48 = 40 units.

⇒ Time taken by **C** alone = Work ÷ Efficiency = 40 ÷ 1 = **40 days**.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 days.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

Uses the same efficiency-based approach where an inlet pipe has positive efficiency and an outlet pipe (leak) has negative efficiency.

Work & Wages

Wages are generally distributed in the ratio of the work done by each person, which is proportional to their efficiencies when they work for the same time.

Efficiency-Time Relation

The time taken to complete a work is inversely proportional to the efficiency of the person (Time ∝ 1/Efficiency).</p

questions.question: Ratio of the ages of A and B is x : 10. B is 18 years younger than to C. After nine years C will be 50 years old. If the difference between the ages of A and B is same as the age of C, what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find **C's current age**: 50 − 9 = 41 years.

Find **B's current age**: 41 − 18 = 23 years.

Find **A's age** from given condition (A − B = C): 23 + 41 = 64 years.

Equate the **ratio** A/B = x/10 ⇒ 64/23 = x/10.

Calculate **x**: (64 × 10) ÷ 23 ≈ 27.82.

**∴ The correct answer is 27.82.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of ages of **A** and **B** = x : 10

Age of **B** = Age of **C** − 18

Age of **C** after 9 years = 50 years

Difference |Age of **A** − Age of **B**| = Age of **C**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a1268cc3ace7683581a698bfc514f4ee409ebdf7ca49edbd59ac2353276f78b.png] 

**Step-by-step Calculation:**

⇒ Current age of **C** = 50 − 9 = 41 years

⇒ Current age of **B** = 41 − 18 = 23 years

⇒ Given: |A − B| = C

⇒ |A − 23| = 41

⇒ Case 1: A − 23 = 41 ⇒ A = 64 years

⇒ Case 2: 23 − A = 41 ⇒ A = −18 (Not possible as age cannot be negative)

⇒ Current age of **A** = 64 years

⇒ Ratio A : B = x : 10

⇒ 64 / 23 = x / 10

⇒ x = (64 × 10) / 23

⇒ x = 640 / 23

⇒ x ≈ 27.826

**∴ The correct answer is 27.82.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Properties

A ratio a:b can be written as a/b. If a:b = c:d, then product of extremes (a×d) equals product of means (b×c).

Problems on Ages

The difference between the ages of two people remains **constant** regardless of the number of years passed or subtracted.

Age After 'n' Years

If the current age is P, then the age after 'n' years is P + n and the age 'n' years ago was P − n.</p

questions.question: If one diagonal of a rhombus is equal to its side, then the diagonals of the rhombus are in the ratio of:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

One diagonal of a rhombus is equal to its side.

**Concept used:**

All sides of a rhombus are equal.

Diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at 90°.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/521eeacb6ef778c40d31df3edf49c7db733aa9455e49ac144100fcf5a15ec312.png] 

Let the side of the rhombus be A.

⇒ CD = AC = A

In ΔDOC,

⇒ CD² = OC² + OD²

⇒ A² = (A/2)² + OD²

⇒ OD² = A² − A²/4

⇒ OD² = (4A² − A²)/4

⇒ OD = √(3A²/4)

⇒ OD = (√3A)/2

Now,

⇒ BD = OD + OB

⇒ BD = (√3A)/2 + (√3A)/2

⇒ BD = √3A

Required ratio = AC : BD

⇒ A : √3A

⇒ 1 : √3

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question:
Which of the following offers is better for the shopkeeper ?

(1.) buy 2 get 1 free

(2.) buy 3 get 2 free

(3.) buy 3 get 5 free
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

For a **shopkeeper**, the best offer is the one with the **minimum discount percentage**.

Scheme 1: 1 ÷ (2+1) × 100 = **33.33%**

Scheme 2: 2 ÷ (3+2) × 100 = **40.00%**

Scheme 3: 5 ÷ (3+5) × 100 = **62.50%**

The lowest discount (33.33%) is in **Scheme 1**, making it the best for the shopkeeper.

**∴ The correct answer is Scheme 1.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Scheme 1: Buy 2 get 1 free (Paid = 2, Free = 1)

Scheme 2: Buy 3 get 2 free (Paid = 3, Free = 2)

Scheme 3: Buy 3 get 5 free (Paid = 3, Free = 5)

**Formula Used:**

Discount % = [Free Items ÷ (Paid Items + Free Items)] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/664308e91adf65c57e516a00dbaa0cf07ac535d48a640352b0ece1a26907b131.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Discount % for **Scheme 1** = [1 ÷ (2 + 1)] × 100 = [1 ÷ 3] × 100 = 33.33%

⇒ Discount % for **Scheme 2** = [2 ÷ (3 + 2)] × 100 = [2 ÷ 5] × 100 = 40%

⇒ Discount % for **Scheme 3** = [5 ÷ (3 + 5)] × 100 = [5 ÷ 8] × 100 = 62.5%

From the shopkeeper's perspective, an offer is **better** if he gives a **lower discount** to the customers.

Comparing 33.33%, 40%, and 62.5%, the minimum value is 33.33%.

**∴ The correct answer is Scheme 1.**

**__Additional Information__**

Discount in Buy X Get Y Free

The effective discount percentage is always calculated on the total number of items (Paid + Free). Formula: Discount % = [Y ÷ (X + Y)] × 100.

Successive Discounts

If two discounts a% and b% are given successively, the net discount is [a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100]%.

Shopkeeper vs. Customer Perspective

A customer always looks for the **Maximum Discount %**, whereas a shopkeeper prefers the **Minimum Discount %** to maximize his revenue per item sold.</p

questions.question: After giving 20% discount, a shopkeeper still manages to earn 14(2)/(7)% profit. If the marked price of the article is Rs. 1000, then find the cost price of the article.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Ratio of **Cost Price (CP)** to **Marked Price (MP)** is given by (100 − Discount%) : (100 + Profit%).

CP : MP = (100 − 20) : (100 + 14 2/7) = 80 : 114 2/7 = 80 : 800/7.

CP : MP = 7 : 10.

Given **Marked Price** = 10 units = Rs. 1000 ⇒ 1 unit = Rs. 100.

**Cost Price** = 7 units = 7 × 100 = Rs. 700.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 700.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:****Marked Price (MP)** = Rs. 1000, **Discount** = 20%, **Profit** = 14 2/7%.

**Formula:****Selling Price (SP)** = **MP** × (100 − D%)/100 and **CP** = **SP** × 100/(100 + P%).
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/012e9b238d3146d78dda6ea531b839669f66c77bd9df86eca7d8a0cfaa8adf5b.png] 
⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** = 1000 − (20% of 1000)

⇒ **SP** = 1000 − 200 = Rs. 800

⇒ **Profit %** = 14 2/7% = 100/7 % = 1/7 (in fraction)

⇒ **SP** = **CP** × (1 + Profit Fraction) = **CP** × (1 + 1/7) = **CP** × 8/7

⇒ 800 = **CP** × 8/7

⇒ **CP** = (800 × 7) / 8 = 100 × 7 = Rs. 700

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 700.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

CP-MP Relation Formula

The direct relation between **Cost Price** and **Marked Price** is CP/MP = (100 − Discount%) / (100 + Profit%).

Mark-up Percentage

**Mark-up %** = [(MP − CP) / CP] × 100. It is the percentage by which the **Marked Price** is higher than the **Cost Price**.

Profit and Loss on CP

Always remember that **Profit** or **Loss** percentage is calculated on the **Cost Price (CP)** unless stated otherwise in the question.</p

questions.question: ((sin 2alpha+cos 2alpha)²-1)/(cot2alpha-sin2alphacos 2alpha)=?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Expand the **numerator** using the identity **(a+b)²**: (sin 2α + cos 2α)² − 1 = (sin² 2α + cos² 2α + 2 sin 2α cos 2α) − 1 = 2 sin 2α cos 2α.

Simplify the **denominator** by factoring: cot 2α − sin 2α cos 2α = cos 2α (1/sin 2α − sin 2α) = cos 2α (cos² 2α / sin 2α) = cos³ 2α / sin 2α.

Divide the results: (2 sin 2α cos 2α) × (sin 2α / cos³ 2α) = 2 sin² 2α / cos² 2α = 2 tan² 2α.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 tan² 2α.**

questions.question:
Which one is correct for the following data?

-2, 2, 1, 0, 5, 4, 5, 7, 5, 11, 12
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Observe frequencies: **5** appears **3 times** (highest frequency), so **Mode = 5**.

Total items (n) = 11 (odd). Median is the **6th term** in sorted order.

Sorted data: −2, 0, 1, 2, 4, **5**, 5, 5, 7, 11, 12. So, **Median = 5**.

Since Mode = 5 and Median = 5, we have **Median = Mode**.

**∴ The correct answer is Median = Mode.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given Data:** −2, 2, 1, 0, 5, 4, 5, 7, 5, 11, 12

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a4689c97f9f77152d0d19925c854b663ec9c9b9f00a489d77c6e412cbf57f3a.png] 

**1. Calculation of Mean:**

⇒ Sum of all terms = (−2) + 2 + 1 + 0 + 5 + 4 + 5 + 7 + 5 + 11 + 12 = 50

⇒ Total number of terms (n) = 11

⇒ Mean = 50 ÷ 11 ≈ 4.54

**2. Calculation of Median:**

⇒ Ascending Order: −2, 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 5, 5, 7, 11, 12

⇒ Median = [(n + 1) ÷ 2]th term = (11 + 1) ÷ 2 = 6th term

⇒ Median = 5

**3. Calculation of Mode:**

⇒ Frequency of 5 is 3 (maximum).

⇒ Mode = 5

**Comparison:** Mean (4.54) ≠ Median (5), Mean (4.54) ≠ Mode (5), but Median (5) = Mode (5).

**∴ The correct answer is Median = Mode.**

**__Additional Information__**

Empirical Relationship

For a moderately skewed distribution, the relationship is **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean**.

Median for Even Number of Terms

If n is even, Median = Average of (n/2)th and (n/2 + 1)th terms after sorting.

Symmetry and Skewness

In a **perfectly symmetrical** distribution, Mean = Median = Mode. If Mean < Median, the data is **negatively skewed**.</p

questions.question: On a racing track, A and B are standing at a distance of 200 m. A walked towards B at a speed of 8 km/h, whereas B walked in the same direction at a speed of 5 km/h. What was the distance between them 1 minute before they met?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The distance between two objects **before they meet** is simply the distance covered by their **Relative Speed** in that specific time.

Relative speed in same direction = 8 − 5 = 3 km/h.

Convert relative speed to meters per minute ⇒ (3 × 1000) ÷ 60 = 50 m/min.

Distance 1 minute before meeting = 50 m/min × 1 min = 50 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 50 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of **A** = 8 km/h, Speed of **B** = 5 km/h, Initial distance = 200 m, Time before meeting = 1 min.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea95e9192b9c340748002bc3805257428c6bfbcd4ebec048b7f2dc171ae16891.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (Same direction) = S₁ − S₂

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 8 − 5 = 3 km/h

⇒ Convert km/h to m/s ⇒ 3 × (5/18) = 5/6 m/s

⇒ Time = 1 minute = 60 seconds

⇒ Distance before 1 minute = Relative Speed × Time

⇒ Distance = (5/6) × 60

⇒ Distance = 5 × 10 = 50 m

**∴ The correct answer is 50 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the **same direction**, relative speed is S₁ − S₂. When moving in **opposite directions**, it is S₁ + S₂.

Time of Meeting

Meeting Time = Initial Distance ÷ Relative Speed. In this case, 200 m ÷ (5/6) m/s = 240 seconds or 4 minutes.

Unit Conversions

To convert **km/h to m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s to km/h**, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: A person lent certain sum of money at the annual rate of 5 percent on simple interest. In 4 years, the interest amounted to Rs. 800. What is the sum lent?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In **Simple Interest**, the interest percentage is the product of **Rate** and **Time**.

Total Interest % = 5% × 4 = 20%

⇒ 20% of the **Sum lent** = ₹800

⇒ 100% of the **Sum lent** = 800 × (100 ÷ 20) = 800 × 5 = ₹4000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Simple Interest** (SI) = ₹800

**Rate** of interest (R) = 5% per annum

**Time** (T) = 4 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b6da2286951809fdccf1d75de5f70798c12f13c980668e42177665209622c56.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 800 = (P × 5 × 4) ÷ 100

⇒ 800 = (P × 20) ÷ 100

⇒ 800 = P ÷ 5

⇒ P = 800 × 5

⇒ P = ₹4000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

SI = (Principal × Rate × Time) ÷ 100. This assumes the interest is not added back to the principal.

Total Amount

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI). In this case, A = 4000 + 800 = ₹4800.

Rate and Time Relationship

If the Rate is doubled and the Time is halved, the **Simple Interest** remains unchanged as the product R × T stays constant.

questions.question: sqrt[3]{{5frac{{23}}{{64}}}} is equal to:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Convert the **mixed fraction** 5 23/64 into an **improper fraction**: (5 × 64 + 23) / 64 = 343 / 64.

Take the **cube root** of both the numerator and the denominator separately.

√³(343) = 7 and √³(64) = 4.

Final Value = 7 ÷ 4 = 1.75.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.75.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = √³(5 23/64)

**Formula Used:**

1. Mixed fraction a b/c = (a × c + b) / c

2. √³(x / y) = √³x ÷ √³y

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, convert the mixed fraction into an improper fraction:

⇒ 5 23/64 = (5 × 64 + 23) ÷ 64

⇒ 5 23/64 = (320 + 23) ÷ 64 = 343 ÷ 64

⇒ Now, find the cube root of the resulting fraction:

⇒ √³(343 / 64) = √³(343) ÷ √³(64)

⇒ Since 7³ = 343 and 4³ = 64,

⇒ Value = 7 ÷ 4

⇒ Value = 1.75

**∴ The correct answer is 1.75.**

**__Additional Information__**

Cube of Numbers (1-10)

Memorizing basic cubes helps in fast calculations: 1³=1, 2³=8, 3³=27, 4³=64, 5³=125, 6³=216, 7³=343, 8³=512, 9³=729, 10³=1000.

Cube Root of Decimals

To find the cube root of a decimal, convert it to a fraction first. For example, √³(0.125) = √³(125/1000) = 5/10 = 0.5.

Laws of Radicals

The nth root of a product or quotient can be split: √ⁿ(ab) = √ⁿa × √ⁿb and √ⁿ(a/b) = √ⁿa ÷ √ⁿb.</p

questions.question: Two containers with equal capacity have milk and water in the ratio of 3 ∶ 4 and 3 ∶ 1 respectively. If both the containers are emptied into a bigger container having the capacity to contain the whole mixture, then what is the ratio of milk to water in the bigger container?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Equalize the total capacity parts: **Ratio 1** (3+4 = 7) and **Ratio 2** (3+1 = 4).

Find the **LCM** of 7 and 4 = 28.

Scale **Container 1** (multiply by 4) → 12 : 16.

Scale **Container 2** (multiply by 7) → 21 : 7.

Final **Milk : Water** = (12 + 21) : (16 + 7) = 33 : 23.

**∴ The correct answer is 33 : 23.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Container 1** Milk : Water = 3 : 4 (Total = 7 units)

**Container 2** Milk : Water = 3 : 1 (Total = 4 units)

**Condition:** Both **Containers** have equal capacity.

**Formula Used:**

For equal volumes, Total **Milk** = (m₁/t₁ + m₂/t₂) and Total **Water** = (w₁/t₁ + w₂/t₂).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44f18acce04f1be843670887b671b436226042cbbf76a1885a9d92271f360932.png] 

⇒ Let the capacity of each container be the **LCM** of (3 + 4) and (3 + 1).

⇒ Capacity = LCM(7, 4) = 28 units.

⇒ **Milk** in first container = 28 × (3 ÷ 7) = 12 units.

⇒ **Water** in first container = 28 × (4 ÷ 7) = 16 units.

⇒ **Milk** in second container = 28 × (3 ÷ 4) = 21 units.

⇒ **Water** in second container = 28 × (1 ÷ 4) = 7 units.

⇒ Total **Milk** in bigger container = 12 + 21 = 33 units.

⇒ Total **Water** in bigger container = 16 + 7 = 23 units.

⇒ Final **Ratio** = 33 : 23.

**∴ The correct answer is 33 : 23.**

**__Additional Information__**

Rule of Equal Volumes

When containers of equal volume are mixed, the quantity of each component in the final mixture is the sum of the components from each container.

Ratio Scaling

A ratio a : b can be scaled to k×a : k×b without changing its value, which is essential for equalizing totals in mixture problems.

Alligation Rule

The ratio of the weights of two items mixed to get a mean price is (Higher Price − Mean Price) : (Mean Price − Lower Price).</p

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 40 days. He works at it for 10 days, and then B alone finishes the remaining work in 45 days. In how many days will A and B working together finish 75% of the same work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining work after **A** works for 10 days = 1 − 10/40 = 3/4.

**B** finishes 3/4 work in 45 days → **B** finishes full work in 45 × (4/3) = 60 days.

Combined time for 100% work = (40 × 60) / (40 + 60) = 24 days.

Time for 75% work = 24 × 0.75 = 18 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **A** = 40 days, Work done by **A** = 10 days, Time taken by **B** for remaining work = 45 days.

**Formula Used:** Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time taken

⇒ Work done by **A** in 10 days = 10/40 = 1/4 of the total work.

⇒ Remaining work = 1 − 1/4 = 3/4.

⇒ **B** alone takes 45 days to complete 3/4 of the work.

⇒ Time for **B** to complete 100% work = 45 × 4/3 = 60 days.

Combined Efficiency

If two persons **A** and **B** can finish a work in 'x' and 'y' days respectively, then working together they finish the work in (x × y) / (x + y) days.

Work and Time Relation

Work done is directly proportional to the time taken and efficiency: Work = Efficiency × Time.

Fractional Work

If a person completes '1/n' part of work in 't' days, they will complete the full work in 'n × t' days.</p

questions.question: A solid sphere is cut into two pieces and the cost of painting the surface areas of the hemispheres at the rate of Rs. 2.5 per cm² is Rs. 20790. Find the volume of each small cylinder if one of the hemispheres is melted and converted into 63 small cylinders whose height is 2 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A solid sphere is cut into two hemispheres.

Cost of painting the surfaces of both hemispheres at the rate of ₹2.5 per cm² = ₹20790

One hemisphere is melted and recast into 63 small cylinders of height 2 cm each.

**Formula used:**

Total surface area of two hemispheres = 2 × 3πr² = 6πr²

Volume of a hemisphere = (2/3)πr³

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total painted surface area = 20790/2.5 = 8316 cm²

⇒ 6πr² = 8316

⇒ 6 × 22/7 × r² = 8316

⇒ r² = (8316 × 7)/132

⇒ r² = 441

⇒ r = √441 = 21 cm

Now, volume of one hemisphere,

⇒ V = (2/3)πr³

⇒ V = (2/3) × 22/7 × 21 × 21 × 21

⇒ V = 19404 cm³

Volume of each small cylinder,

⇒ 19404/63

⇒ 308 cm³

**Verification:**

Using V = πr²h, where h = 2 cm

⇒ 308 = πr² × 2

⇒ r² = (308 × 7)/(2 × 22)

⇒ r² = 49

⇒ r = 7 cm

**∴ The volume of each small cylinder is 308 cm³.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper sold two articles for ₹560 each. He incurred no loss and made no profit in the transaction because one article was sold at a loss of 16(2)/(3)% and the other article was sold at a profit of:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Loss of 16 2/3% = 1/6 ⇒ **CP₁** : **SP₁** = 6 : 5.

Given **SP** = ₹560 ⇒ 5 units = 560, so 1 unit (Loss) = ₹112.

For **No Profit No Loss**, Profit on the 2nd article must be ₹112.

**CP₂** = SP − Profit = 560 − 112 = ₹448.

Profit% = (112 / 448) × 100 = 1/4 × 100 = 25%.

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price of each article (**SP₁** = **SP₂**) = ₹560

Loss on the first article = 16 2/3%

Overall transaction = **No Profit No Loss**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d92fa98786c1586d4882d410d0b70ad3fbc82e224fb624f0e0fd5b7b1175512c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Loss% = 16 2/3% = 50/3% = 1/6

⇒ CP₁ = SP₁ ÷ (1 − Loss fraction) = 560 ÷ (5/6)

⇒ CP₁ = (560 × 6) ÷ 5 = 672

⇒ Loss Amount = CP₁ − SP₁ = 672 − 560 = ₹112

⇒ Total SP = 560 + 560 = ₹1120

⇒ Since there is no profit and no loss, Total CP = Total SP = ₹1120

⇒ CP₂ = Total CP − CP₁ = 1120 − 672 = ₹448

⇒ Profit on second article = SP₂ − CP₂ = 560 − 448 = ₹112

⇒ Profit% = (Profit / CP₂) × 100 = (112 / 448) × 100

⇒ Profit% = 1/4 × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

**__Additional Information__**

No Profit No Loss Condition

This occurs when the **Total Cost Price** of all items equals the **Total Selling Price**. Mathematically, Total CP = Total SP.

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

Converting complex percentages to fractions simplifies calculation: 16 2/3% = 1/6, 14 2/7% = 1/7, 12.5% = 1/8, and 11 1/9% = 1/9.

Profit/Loss on CP

Profit or Loss percentage is always calculated on the **Cost Price (CP)** unless specifically mentioned that it is calculated on the Selling Price.

questions.question: A certain sum amounts to ₹25,300 in 2 years at 7.5% p.a., simple interest. What will be the compound interest on the same sum for the same period at double the rate, if the interest is compounded 8-monthly?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total **Simple Interest** rate = 7.5% × 2 = 15%.

Principal (P) = Amount ÷ (100 + SI)% = 25300 ÷ 115% = **₹22,000**.

New **Annual Rate** = 15%; 8-monthly rate = 15% × (8/12) = 10%.

Time = 2 years = 24 months = **3 periods** of 8 months each.

Net **Compound Interest** % for 3 periods at 10% = 33.1%.

CI = 22000 × 33.1% = **₹7,282**.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,282.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹25,300 | Time (T) = 2 years | Rate (R₁) = 7.5% p.a. (Simple Interest)

New Rate (R₂) = 15% p.a. | Compounding = **8-monthly**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/948023edcc8e04ecf69a0b462d6226cfcfd72af8922b0dde01b607e7fc693600.png] 

**Step 1: Calculate the Principal (P)**

⇒ Amount = P + (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 25300 = P + (P × 7.5 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ 25300 = P + 0.15P = 1.15P

⇒ P = 25300 ÷ 1.15 = **₹22,000**

**Step 2: Calculate CI for the new condition**

⇒ New annual rate = 2 × 7.5% = 15% p.a.

⇒ Interest is compounded **8-monthly**.

⇒ Effective rate per period (r) = 15% × (8/12) = 10% per period.

⇒ Total period (n) = 2 years ÷ 8 months = 24 ÷ 8 = 3 periods.

⇒ Amount (Aₙₑw) = P × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

⇒ Aₙₑw = 22000 × (1 + 10/100)³ = 22000 × (1.1)³

⇒ Aₙₑw = 22000 × 1.331 = ₹29,282

⇒ Compound Interest (CI) = Aₙₑw − P

⇒ CI = 29282 − 22000 = **₹7,282**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹7,282.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for 8-Monthly Compounding

When interest is compounded k-monthly, the rate per period is (Annual Rate × k/12) and the number of periods is (Total Months ÷ k).

CI vs SI for the First Year

For the first year (or first compounding period), Simple Interest and Compound Interest are equal if the principal and rate are the same.

3-Period CI Shortcut

The effective interest rate for 3 periods at r% is given by: 3r + 3r²/100 + r³/10000. For r = 10%, this equals 30 + 3 + 0.1 = 33.1%.

questions.question: If the polynomial (2x³ + ax² + 3x - 5) and (x³ + x² - 2x + a) leave the same remainder when divided by (x-2), find the remainder.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

By **Remainder Theorem**, equate **P(2)** and **Q(2)** because they leave the same remainder when divided by (x − 2).

2(2)³ + a(2)² + 3(2) − 5 = (2)³ + (2)² − 2(2) + a

16 + 4a + 6 − 5 = 8 + 4 − 4 + a ⇒ 17 + 4a = 8 + a

3a = −9 ⇒ a = −3

Substitute a = −3 in Q(2): Remainder = 8 + (−3) = 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Polynomial** P(x) = 2x³ + ax² + 3x − 5

**Polynomial** Q(x) = x³ + x² − 2x + a

**Divisor** = (x − 2)

According to the **Remainder Theorem**, when a polynomial f(x) is divided by (x − c), the **remainder** is f(c).

Here, c = 2. Let the remainders be R₁ and R₂.

⇒ R₁ = P(2) = 2(2)³ + a(2)² + 3(2) − 5

⇒ R₁ = 2(8) + 4a + 6 − 5 = 16 + 4a + 1 = 17 + 4a

⇒ R₂ = Q(2) = (2)³ + (2)² − 2(2) + a

⇒ R₂ = 8 + 4 − 4 + a = 8 + a

Since the problem states both polynomials leave the **same remainder**:

⇒ R₁ = R₂

⇒ 17 + 4a = 8 + a

⇒ 4a − a = 8 − 17

⇒ 3a = −9

⇒ a = −3

Now, find the **actual remainder** by substituting a = −3 into either R₁ or R₂:

⇒ Remainder = 8 + a = 8 + (−3) = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

**__Additional Information__**

Remainder Theorem

If a **polynomial** f(x) is divided by (x − a), the **remainder** is simply the value of the polynomial at x = a, denoted as f(a).

Factor Theorem

A special case of the remainder theorem where if f(a) = 0, then (x − a) is a **factor** of the polynomial f(x).

Division Algorithm

For any polynomials p(x) and g(x), there exist unique polynomials q(x) and r(x) such that p(x) = g(x) × q(x) + r(x), where **degree** of r(x) < degree of g(x).</p

Compounding Period Adjustment

questions.question: The interior angle of a regular polygon exceeds its exterior angle by 108°. The number of sides of the polygon is
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Interior angle − Exterior angle = 108°

**Formula used:**

Interior angle of a regular polygon = ((n − 2)/n) × 180°

Where, n = Number of sides of the regular polygon

Interior angle + Exterior angle = 180°

**Calculation:**

Let the exterior angle of the polygon be x.

⇒ Interior angle = x + 108°

⇒ x + (x + 108°) = 180°

⇒ 2x = 180° − 108°

⇒ 2x = 72°

⇒ x = 72°/2 = 36°

⇒ Interior angle = 36° + 108° = 144°

Now,

⇒ ((n − 2)/n) × 180 = 144

⇒ 1 − 2/n = 144/180

⇒ −2/n = 144/180 − 1

⇒ 2/n = 1 − 144/180

⇒ 2/n = 36/180

⇒ n = (180/36) × 2 = 10

**∴ The number of sides of the polygon is 10.**

questions.question: Akash is thrice as good a workman as Arvind and therefore is able to finish a job in 30 days less than Arvind. If they work together, in how many days can they finish the job?

Akash takes 15 days and Arvind takes 45 days.

Time working together = (15 × 45) ÷ (15 + 45) = 675 ÷ 60 = 45 ÷ 4 = 11¹/₄ days.

Akash is thrice as good a workman as Arvind.

Akash takes 30 days less than Arvind to finish the same job.

Efficiency ∝ 1 ÷ Time

⇒ Time ratio of Akash to Arvind = 1 : 3

⇒ Let time taken by Akash be x days and by Arvind be 3x days.

⇒ Difference in days = 3x − x = 2x

⇒ 2x = 30 ⇒ x = 15

⇒ Time taken by Akash = 15 days

⇒ Time taken by Arvind = 15 × 3 = 45 days

⇒ Total combined efficiency = 3 + 1 = 4 units/day

⇒ Time taken working together = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency = 45 ÷ 4

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Time & Efficiency Relationship

The efficiency of a worker is inversely proportional to the time they take to complete a task. If the ratio of efficiencies is a : b, the time ratio will be b : a.
